notes.title: Obsolete Souls™ Update 2.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed player softlock issue when leaving the Acadia inn at night time.

- Fixed game crashing in the "The End" boss fight with Aria, Dex, and Vinny.

- Re-packaged the RTP into the build for users unable to open the game from missing DLL files.

notes.title: Notice for users running into error "RPGVXAce RTP is required to run this game."
notes.content: Some players may have lost access to their run time package amidst the update installation process. Users in this predicament can resolve this issue by downloading a new run time package from RPG Maker's official website. Please be sure to select the RPG Maker VX Ace program, and follow the instructions provided to ensure the run time package is correctly installed. - https://www.rpgmakerweb.com/run-time-package

notes.title: The Obsolete Souls™ Soundtrack is available for download!
Patch Notes for version 1.9 of Obsolete Souls
notes.content:
- Fixed random game crashing in Itwern Cavern and Kentron E.
(This crash was tied to missing files for Aria's character, so other crashes that may have occurred while using this character should be fixed as well.)

- Itwern Cavern ice puzzle has been altered for easier level progression.

- Pause menu name icons have had their name text decreased in size for cleaner UI.

- Game credits have been updated to reflect name changes.

notes.title: Patch notes for April 11th 2021.
notes.content:
[i]*Remember to copy over your save files in case of installation/update issues!*[/i]
 
Sluj enemy now has a 1/3 chance of dropping sluj goop instead of 1/5.

"Sluj Goop Collector" quest no longer has a chance of freezing the player after completing the quest.

Entering Sheehan's shack or Rami's shack after defeating the King Sea Haegan no longer refreshes the Karakapala map.

notes.title: Obsolete Souls™ is available now!
notes.content: We are very excited to say that Obsolete Souls™ is now available to download as a free to play game! Happy 2 year anniversary to Obsolete Souls™!  (This download also serves as version 1.7. This version of the game can also be downloaded from the game's official website at www.obsoletesouls.com).
